_meta.document: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 (amended, notified 5-Jun-2004; subsequent amendments up to 2022)
secondary_documents: NBC 2016 Part IV — Fire & Life Safety (cross-referenced in fire sections)
BDA RMP 2031 — cross-referenced for setbacks and FAR
_meta.notes: Values sourced from BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003 Sections 8–35 and NBC 2016 Part IV. VERIFY all fields against the official gazette before use in production.

height_based_minimums._note: Overrides usage-based minimum only if it yields a HIGHER value. Take max(height_min, usage_min).

upto_11_5m.note: Standard residential buildings up to G+3

11_5m_to_15m.note: Buildings between 11.5 m and 15 m height (BBMP Bylaws)

above_15m.note: Fire-escape staircase for buildings above 15 m (NBC 2016 Part IV Cl. 4.1)

count_thresholds.note: 2 staircases mandatory above 2,000 sqm built-up area

enclosure_rules.above_15m: Staircase must be fully enclosed by fire-rated construction
enclosure_rules.upto_g3_residential: Need not be self-contained unit; adjacent to external wall not mandatory
enclosure_rules.open_staircase_in_setback: Permitted for residential plots <= 120 sqm (in side or rear setback)

lifts._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.9.1(iv) and 4.9.6; BBMP Bye-Laws Section 20.7
lifts.note: Lift mandatory above G+3 (i.e., 4 floors and above) or above 15 m — whichever triggers first

service_lift.combined_allowed_if: Building has < 24 units OR < 2,400 sqm BUA (whichever lower)
service_lift.note: Service lift may double as passenger lift for smaller buildings

disabled_access_lift.note: BIS 13-person passenger lift standard (Schedule XI, BBMP Bye-Laws)

corner_plot.note: On both roads for 5 m from the intersection; wall to be rounded or chamfered

exceptions: Women's hostels — may exceed standard height with special BBMP permission

basement._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.9.2; BBMP Bye-Laws 2003, Section 18
basement.definition: Storey partly or wholly below average ground level. Max projection above average ground: 1.2 m (BDA RMP 2031) / 1.0 m (BBMP 2003)

setbacks.extension_below_ground_note: Basement may extend below ground beyond the above-ground setback provided the underground portion is within the plot

basement.small_plot_restriction: Sites < 200 sqm with depth < 20 m: car parking NOT permitted in basement
basement.zone_a_restriction: Zone A only: only 1 basement permitted if site >= 500 sqm with min road width 12 m
permitted_uses: Electrical room, pump room, generator, AC plant room
Dark rooms for X-ray / light-sensitive materials
Bank safes / strong room (counted in FAR)
permitted_only_for_3star_plus_hotels: Dining area with or without kitchen
fire_requirements_above_200sqm: Sprinklers mandatory in basement regardless of height
Minimum 2 means of escape from basement
basement.waterproofing: Walls and floors must be watertight to resist sub-soil hydraulic pressure
basement.far_note: Basement NOT counted in FAR when used exclusively for parking / services

accessibility._source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Schedule XI (Bye-law 31.0); BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.9.1(vii)
accessibility.mandatory_trigger: All public and semi-public buildings with covered area >= 300 sqm

toilet.note: 1 special WC per set with wash basin

guiding_floor_material.note: Tactile guiding block flooring for visually impaired

parking_standards._source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Table 23 (Parking Regulations); amended 2022 for EV mandate

car_space.note: Clear dimensions; column stubs and pilasters must not intrude into space

ev_charging.note: Minimum 5% of total parking spaces to be EV-charging-ready (BBMP amendment 2022)

requirements_by_usage._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.13 Table 4 (quantum); BBMP Table 23 (physical standards)

rainwater_harvesting._source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Section 25 and BWSSB (Cauvery Water Supply) Act amendments
rainwater_harvesting.note: Rainwater harvesting mandatory for all new buildings on plots >= 120 sqm. BWSSB water/sewage connection withheld without compliance certificate.

pit_and_sump.min_sump_capacity_formula: 20 litres per sqm of roof area

habitable_room.note: At least one window opening directly to external air or ventilation shaft

plinth._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.9.1(ii); BBMP Bye-Laws 2003, Section 19
plinth.low_lying_area_note: In flood-prone or low-lying areas, plinth height shall be fixed by BBMP to ensure adequate drainage gradient

fire_safety._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.11 and 4.19; BBMP Bye-Laws 2003 Section 23; NBC 2016 Part IV
fire_safety.governing_code: NBC 2016 Part IV — Fire and Life Safety

tender_access.note: Fire tender access road required on at least 3 sides for buildings above 15 m (NBC 2016 Part IV Cl. 4.1)

staircase_for_fire_egress.note: Staircase shall not be arranged around a lift shaft unless lift is fully enclosed by fire-rated construction

requirements_above_9m: Fire escape staircase — minimum 1.2 m clear width
Emergency lighting in corridors and staircases
Fire tender access road — min 4.5 m wide, 4.5 m height clearance, 9 m turning radius
requirements_above_15m: Fire lift — minimum 1.1 m x 2.1 m car, 630 kg capacity
Hose reel and extinguishers on every floor
requirements_above_24m: Fire command centre at ground level
Two separate fire escape staircases mandatory

refuge_area.note: Refuge area NOT counted in FAR (NBC 2016 Part IV Section 4.11)

solar_and_green._source: BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.15; BESCOM energy efficiency bye-laws

solar_water_heating.requirement: Solar Water Heating System + Solar Lighting in common areas and outdoor lighting
solar_water_heating.occupancy_certificate: Issued only after installation of solar systems to satisfaction of BBMP / BESCOM

energy_efficiency.note: Large commercial buildings (> 500 sqm) encouraged to comply with ECBC (Energy Conservation Building Code)

recreational_open_space.note: Group housing / apartment schemes with > 10 units: 10% of site area must be kept as recreational open space

tree_planting.note: At least one tree per 30 sqm of open / unpaved area

sanitation._source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Section 22; NBC 2016 Part IX

wc_per_usage._note: Minimum WC / urinal count per floor for public / commercial buildings

plumbing.note: All sanitary drainage to BBMP sewer; septic tank only where public sewer unavailable

balcony.far_exclusion: Balconies within permitted projection limits excluded from FAR
balcony.max_projection_as_fraction_of_setback: 1/3 of setback or max projection limit — whichever is less

chajja_sun_shade.note: Chajja / sun shade up to 0.75 m not counted in FAR

mezzanine_floor._source: BBMP Bye-Laws 2003 Section 20.4; BDA RMP 2031 Section 4.9.1(iii)
mezzanine_floor.permitted_between: Any two floors in residential buildings
mezzanine_floor.accessibility: Accessible only from its lower floor

signage_and_hoardings.note: Signage / hoardings require separate BBMP advertisement permission
